summary: Master financial accounting tailored for NGOs with our expert-led course. Gain essential skills to boost your organization's financial health and compliance.
lede: Financial Accounting for NGOs gives finance professionals practical methods to manage restricted and unrestricted funds, allocate grant costs, reconcile accounts, and produce reliable financial reports. Through worked examples and reconciliation exercises, you build stronger control over transactions, budgets, and supporting documentation. The course helps turn fragmented finance tasks into consistent routines, including chart of accounts design, budget-versus-actual analysis, month-end close, and donor-report preparation. You will create practical tools such as a cost allocation matrix, a month-end close checklist, and a donor financial reporting pack while learning how AI-assisted checks can help identify inconsistencies earlier.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle NGO accounting, grant finance, budgeting, and financial reporting across projects, donors, and control environments.
modules: Chart of Accounts and Fund Coding
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and familiarity with basic accounting entries. If your organization uses QuickBooks, Sage, or another cloud accounting system, you may use it during practice, but no programming is required.
